newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan floods leave 9,000 homeless, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan floods leave 9,000 homeless, one dead.

text.p: Floodwaters in central Venezuela swept away homes and bridges, leaving about 9,000 people homeless and killing at least one, authorities said on Sunday.

Three days of torrential rain sent river levels soaring and turned valleys into rivers of mud, sweeping away about 1,800 homes in the densely populated Valles del Tuy, 40 miles (64 km) southeast of Caracas
"It's a very serious situation which has affected about 9,000 people," said Victor Manuel Hernandez, secretary of the Miranda State governor's office.
One man drowned after falling into the rising waters and another was unaccounted for, he said.
Houses in the shantytowns that cling precariously to the valley sides surrounding the capital are frequently washed away during the summer wet season.
